body:
PR #4251 (STORY-2897 S1) ready for rereview at 538d66d3496a849e792f56039c5b2b2f2dde18bb (round 3 of 4 per your ruling), scoped to the 4 round-1 findings. check-ci-fast rc 0, pushed, ci:full relabeled.
1 no-new-failures: fails closed (refuses every promotion; never clean-main). Unit test on a real repo.
2 floor: final_landing_recheck re-reads has_integrity_floor_authority after the waits; entry-held but lapsed -> Review refusal; the fresh value decides advisor-merger and C2. Pure helper gate::ship::floor_lapse_refusal + a lib test of final_landing_recheck on a real origin.
3 default ref: the recheck also fetches the trusted default branch when it differs from the PR base. Lib test + CLI production-path test (PR into integration, origin main alone sets merger=advisor -> refused, exit 23). Mutation-checked: with the default fetch disabled the CLI test fails.
4 categories: typed refusals; authority/policy -> Review (23); only a base/head fetch failure stays BehindBase; the review-gated author CLI test asserts exit 23.
Commits: b9bccdbde6c (fix + tests + docs), then the exec-context re-key for the moved PATH read.
Model-side mail poll removed (cron deleted).
subject: PR-4251 ready for rereview at 538d66d3496
